Radiology contrast media - categories #3

  • Barium (ONLY orally: X-ray)

  • IV injection
  • Urography (IVP)

  • Phlebography (rare)
  • Intraarterial injection
  • Digital subtraction angiography (DSA)
  • Other applications
  • Myelography (!)
  • Arthrography
  • Fistulography
  • Retrograde pyelography, etc.

Renal function!!!! #13

  • Iodinated + gadolinium

incidence < 1 % #14

  • frequency < 1/1000
  • incidence < 1/100000

Complications and hazards #19

  • slight
  • malaise
  • nausea
  • sweating
  • Skin rash
  • urticaria
  • tachicardia
  • incidence < 1 %

Complications and hazards #20

  • severe
  • General severe malaise
  • vomits
  • diarrhoea
  • hypotension
  • Colapse
  • Loss of consciousness
  • Glottic edema (dispnoea)
  • bronchospasm
  • frequency < 1/1000

Complications and hazards #21

  • Very severe
  • shock
  • seizures
  • Cardio-respiratory arrest
  • Coma
  • incidence < 1/100000

Gadolinium Toxicity #22

  • Allergic reactions (very rare)
  • Nephrogenic systemic fibrosis

US – bubble destruction #23

  • NO:
  • pregnancy
  • Ischemic heart disease
  • Ocular disease

Contraindications for using iodinated contrast media #24

  • Absolute
  • Liver + kidney failure
  • Intolerance to iodine +
  • Renal failure
  • Liver failure
  • sepsis
  • Several medical-surgical emergencies (shock, burns)
  • Terminal state

Contraindications for using iodinated contrast media #25

  • Relative (temporary)
  • Intolerance to iodine
  • Allergic disease (astma, known allergies to antibiotics, hay, pollen etc)
  • Hiperthyroidism (b. Basedow, Graves)
  • Cardio-circulatory failure
  • pregnancy

Allergic-like reaction to contrast media: treatment #26

  • Moderate accidents
  • Reassurance
  • Antiemetics

Allergic-like reaction to contrast media: treatment #27

  • severe accidents
  • Cardio-respiratory resuscitation
  • Cardiac massage
  • Assisted / artificial respiration
  • Tracheal intubation
  • Quick venous access
  • Antishock position
  • Reduce vascular bed
  • Ephedrine/Adrenaline

Prophylaxis #28

  • Know and explore contraindiactions !!
  • Preventive treatment
  • Anxiety – Reassurance, sedatives/hypnotics
  • Allergy / known prior reactions:
  • cortisone, antihistamines
